prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original square card portrait for the Buried Coil card in an original woodland river-workshop battler
Primary request: Paint a distinctive copper defensive device for a card thumbnail, centered on its transition from hidden hatch to revealed lookout.
Scene/backdrop: An alderwood river workshop at a sluice, with a few broad leaves, timber beams, and soft river spray in the distance.
Subject: One buried defensive coil: a low round copper hatch opened to reveal a compact, sturdy lookout tower rising from beneath it. Give the tower a three-footed silhouette, a bright amber emberseed core, and two thick copper coil rings at the crown. Keep metal, wood, hatch, and emberseed visibly separate.
Style/medium: Original polished hand-painted game illustration with confident contours, broad material shapes, warm copper highlights, moss greens, dark riverwood, and ember amber.
Composition/framing: Square close portrait, one device filling the center; show both the hatch rim and the complete coil crown. Keep the silhouette readable when reduced to a small square card thumbnail. Background stays secondary and uncluttered.
Lighting/mood: Warm emberseed glow against cool river mist; crafted, quietly vigilant.
Constraints: Original design only. No text, lettering, logo, watermark, card frame, UI, people, or creatures. Do not resemble or name any existing commercial game assets or characters.
